instruction_loading.mechanism: Saved prompt system instructions exist, but repository-wide automatic AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md loading is not documented for AI Studio Build mode.

filesystem.mechanism: Build mode manages an application file tree in a hosted development container; general sovereign host filesystem access is not documented.

git.mechanism: Documented GitHub import and two-way sync UI, not a general Git CLI or governed branch/lease executor.

secure_github.mechanism: AI Studio Settings can link/import GitHub repositories; exact installation permissions and least-privilege suitability require owner review.

persistent_storage.mechanism: Application code persists through AI Studio/GitHub; deployed apps may connect to network storage or Firebase, but storage is application state, not authoritative operations unless explicitly adopted.

background_scheduling.mechanism: No official AI Studio Build-mode background scheduler for persistent agents was verified.

cross_prompt_activation.mechanism: No independent cross-prompt activation mechanism was verified.

subagents.mechanism: The Build agent manages multiple files, but a governed user-configurable multi-agent/subagent interface was not verified.

inbox_events.mechanism: No native inbox polling or event loop was verified; a separately deployed service would be required.

secret_storage.mechanism: Build mode documents server-side Secrets for application keys; never put repository credentials in source, client code, prompts, or model memory.

deployment_boundary.mechanism: Publishing deploys a separate Cloud Run service and is an external mutation requiring separate authority; this profile performs none.
